creator: Codex custom parametric Blender modeling, 2026-10-23
tool: Blender 5.2, scripted mesh authoring; Cycles CPU studio render
source: build_chair.py; editable named components in mori_bentwood_chair.blend
third_party_assets: Original custom geometry plus CC0 texture maps: Poly Haven smoked_walnut_veneer by Jenelle van Heerden. Source https://polyhaven.com/a/smoked_walnut_veneer ; license https://polyhaven.com/license . Derived color: source linear RGB multiplied .55. Derived roughness: .55 + .15 times source value, yielding .55-.70. No normal map.
design: Continuous steam-bent rear leg/back bow, curved lumbar crest, molded dished wood seat with rolled edge, splayed tapered front legs, tucked underseat rails and slender side stretchers. Source repeat 1m. Horizontal grain U follows swept cumulative length of bow/legs; physical circumference V. Seat planar with longitudinal grain; crest horizontal grain. No added geometry.
export: Single joined mesh, one material, meter scale; Godot Y-up, feet at Y=0, front -Z and back +Z.
validation: Actual evaluated mesh audit stored in audit.json; CPU studio PNG inspected. No Godot, GPU, production edits or installed acceptance.
license: Original project geometry; texture maps CC0, with attribution and source retained for provenance.
